exercises.prompt: Select the irregular contracted imperative of أَخَذَ ('take!'):
exercises.explanation: أَخَذَ, أَكَلَ, and أَمَرَ drop both prosthetic alif and initial hamza in the imperative: خُذْ, كُلْ, مُرْ.

feedback.rule: Irregular imperatives of initial-hamza verbs: خُذْ, كُلْ, مُرْ.

exercises.prompt: How is the 1st-person singular imperfect ('I take') of أَخَذَ spelled?
exercises.explanation: Two hamzas in the same syllable (أَأْ) contract into maddah (آ): آخُذُ.
